question: Limitations Law of 1859 is related to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Loan bonds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Limitations Law of 1859** is related to **loan bonds.**
 
• The law was enacted during the British colonial period in India.
 
• It aimed at setting a statute of limitations for the enforcement of loan bonds and other forms of debt recovery.
 
• This legislation was part of the broader legal framework established by the British to regulate financial transactions and debt obligations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Indian Contract Act of 1872** also played a significant role in shaping the legal landscape for financial transactions in colonial India.
 
• The **Statute of Limitations** was essential for ensuring that claims were made within a reasonable time frame, thus bringing predictability and stability to financial dealings.
 
• The law specified the time periods within which different types of legal actions could be initiated.
 
• Understanding historical laws like the Limitations Law of 1859 helps in comprehending the evolution of financial and legal systems in India.
